Based on the investigation:

**Source (source of truth + compile-time dependents):**
- `src/types/api.ts` — defines the `ErrorCode` union itself; a new member starts here.
- `src/lib/errors.ts` — `HTTP_STATUS_BY_CODE: Readonly<Record<ErrorCode, number>>` is a total mapping over the union, so TypeScript won't compile until the new code gets an HTTP status; `toAppError()` also needs the new mapping logic.
- `src/actions/_lib/action-errors.ts` — the action-layer error classes each carry a `readonly code: ErrorCode`; a new error condition typically means adding a class here whose `code` is the new member.
- `tests/lib/errors.test.ts` — per-class coverage of `toAppError`/`HTTP_STATUS_BY_CODE`; needs a new case for the new error class/code.

**Docs (explicitly enumerate every member, so they go stale on any addition):**
- `docs/adr/ADR-014-domain-errors-to-error-codes.md` — ADR listing all current codes with HTTP statuses and thrown-class mappings.
- `docs/api/actions-overview.md` — tables enumerating every thrown class → `ErrorCode` → HTTP status, plus text citing "the nine `ErrorCode` values."
- `docs/glossary.md` — prose spelling out all codes and their statuses.
- `docs/design/action-wrapper-and-errors.md` — table of error classes with `code` literals and a section explicitly citing the full set of `ErrorCode` values.

ANSWER: src/types/api.ts, src/lib/errors.ts, src/actions/_lib/action-errors.ts, tests/lib/errors.test.ts, docs/adr/ADR-014-domain-errors-to-error-codes.md, docs/api/actions-overview.md, docs/glossary.md, docs/design/action-wrapper-and-errors.md
